messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — SEV: P1 — Billing metering pipeline: delayed emits + token-count drift detected for subset of customers. Auto-alert fired: duplicate-emit-rate > 5% over 10m. Please ACK.

devon: acked. I'm taking first touch. what's the scope? :mag:

emma: i'm on standby (oncall). devon - handoff in 2 if you need to shift.

devon: looks like the aggregator's async ack queue didn't ack Redis writes between 03:18-03:26 UTC. Billing worker retried and caused ~2x emits for some requests. billing-bot shows 14 customers got overage flags. logs:

```
2026-03-15T03:20:41Z billing-agg INFO emit id=abc123 status=ok attempts=2
2026-03-15T03:21:05Z billing-agg WARN retrying emit id=xyz789 cause=redis-timeout
```

sahil: can you run the quick dedupe query on prod telemetry?

devon: running now. SQL:

```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as emits, array_agg(token_count) as samples
FROM metering.emits
WHERE emitted_at BETWEEN '2026-03-15 03:15:00' AND '2026-03-15 03:30:00'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY emits DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

devon: results show 1200 duplicate emits across 14 customers, peak at customer_c (420 duplicate rows). support: any customer escalations yet?

support: got 3 customer messages about overage emails, all within the affected window. I flagged to CS. No charge applied yet — flags only.

emma: plan: 1) pause emitter to stop further duplicates 2) run dedupe backfill job with dedupe_id filter 3) reconcile metering delta and suppress overage emails until reconciliation completes. I'll take handoff in 2.

devon: paused emitter (deploy command):

```
# temporary pause
kubectl scale deployment billing-emitter --replicas=0 -n prod
```

billing-bot: paused emitter: billing-emitter -> 0 replicas (actor: devon)

sahil: starting backfill job with dry-run first. ETA ~20m.

emma: rolling actions: will set support slack message template to 'we're investigating false overage flags' and disable automated overage emails by flipping feature-flag 'billing.overage.email' -> false.

support: template ready, sending to affected customers after we verify suppression.

devon: started dedupe backfill job (job id 20260315-dedupe-01). monitoring token aggregates. will post delta when done.

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by devon, oncall=emma. Next update due in 15m. Retain channel for postmortem.

emma: tagging for postmortem: probable root cause is unacked async writes in Redis client after transient network blip; we'll capture heap and client metrics. devon, keep logs and timeline.

support: quick note — do not resume automated overage emails until engineering confirms reconciled counts.

devon: will follow up with final counts and a mitigation summary. :white_check_mark:

sahil: if we need urgent billing fixes, i can hotfix the emitter to add idempotency keys rather than only relying on dedupe later.

emma: good idea — after backfill we'll deploy idempotency patch behind feature flag.

last: devon: update: backfill completed, removed 1187 duplicate emits, suppressed 14 overage flags. reconciliation delta posted to billing.recon table. closing pager to follow up with postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — P1 mitigated. Please file postmortem in #postmortems/incidents within 48h.
